known_outcome: The Board varies the decision of the local authority.; It is the determination of the Board that a water shuttle method of providing water for firefighting can be acceptable provided that it is demonstrated to meet the requirements of NFPA 1142 – “Standard on Water Supplies for Suburban and Rural Fire Fighting”.
review_focus: available water volume and delivery, NFPA 1142 demonstration, reliability of staffing and apparatus, source access under all climate conditions
